title: On Encountering a stranger on the north road
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：encounter　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 encounter 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the father ① encountered a stranger on the north road at once, and every neighbour in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the father ② encounters a stranger on the north road in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ encounter a stranger on the north road at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ encountered a stranger on the north road before — a line in the letter for September 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Encountering a stranger on the north road at once, the father said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ encounter nothing worse than the rain in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Encounter nothing worse than the rain at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the letter, and a new neighbour from the next house ⑧ encounters nothing worse than the rain at once every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the door, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ encountered a stranger on the north road again when nobody else would.

⑩ To encounter a stranger on the north road, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the house remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the house forgets, somebody encounters a stranger on the north road in the rain again and somebody must encounter a stranger on the north road at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 遇到（一般过去式 encountered a stranger on the north road：1973 年父亲头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 遇到（一般现在 encounters a stranger on the north road：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 遇到（不定式 to encounter a stranger on the north road：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 遇到（过去完成时 had encountered a stranger on the north road：1967 年九月的家书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 遇到（动名词 encountering a stranger on the north road 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 遭遇（encounter nothing worse than the rain：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去遭遇遇上的麻烦不过是一场雨）
G. v. 遭遇（encounter nothing worse than the rain：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 遇到（后段两处：新来的邻居照例 encounters nothing worse than the rain，而母亲又一次 encountered a stranger on the north road）

answers.why: encounter 意为“遇到”，1973 年父亲二话不说地遇到在北路上遇见一个生人，那是老屋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 encountered。
encounter 意为“遇到”，自那以后父亲淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 encounters。
encounter 意为“遇到”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯遇到在北路上遇见一个生人”，此处为不定式 to encounter a stranger on the north road。
encounter 意为“遇到”，家书里 九月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人遇到过，故用过去完成时 had encountered。
encounter 意为“遇到”，父亲说“遇到在北路上遇见一个生人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 encountering a stranger on the north road 作主语。
encounter 意为“遭遇”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去遭遇遇上的麻烦不过是一场雨”，should ever 之后用原形 encounter nothing worse than the rain。
encounter 意为“遭遇”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻遭遇遇上的麻烦不过是一场雨（encounter nothing worse than the rain at once），以后再也不要提起。
encounter 意为“遇到”，新来的邻居每个月份都照例遭遇遇上的麻烦不过是一场雨，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 encounters。
encounter 意为“遇到”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地遇到在北路上遇见一个生人，用一般过去式 encountered 叙述。
encounter 意为“遇到”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要遇到在北路上遇见一个生人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和老屋记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年，父亲二话不说地遇到在北路上遇见一个生人；老屋里每一个邻居都说这是头一回。（encountered a stranger on the north road）
多年以后，父亲仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（encounters a stranger on the north road）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯遇到在北路上遇见一个生人这件事本身。（to encounter a stranger on the north road）
早在 1967 年就有人遇到在北路上遇见一个生人，九月那天家书上的一行字就是证据。（had encountered a stranger on the north road）
父亲说过，二话不说地遇到在北路上遇见一个生人这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（encountering a stranger on the north road 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻遭遇遇上的麻烦不过是一场雨，以后再也不要提起。（encounter nothing worse than the rain，祈使句）
answers: In 1973 the father encountered a stranger on the north road at once, and every neighbour in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the father still encounters a stranger on the north road in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to encounter a stranger on the north road at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had encountered a stranger on the north road long before 1980, and the line in the letter for September proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 encounter 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the father encountered a stranger on the north road at once, and nobody in the house forgot it.
Even now the father encounters a stranger on the north road in the rain whenever the house asks.
Encountering a stranger on the north road at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever encounter nothing worse than the rain in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next house encounters nothing worse than the rain at once every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother encountered a stranger on the north road again, and the house remembered that half.
